text: Program Description 1. Traning Objectives Editor Note: Students of this major mainly study the basic theories and knowledge of management, economics and enterprise management, receive basic training in enterprise management methods and skills, and have the basic ability to analyze and solve enterprise management problems. This major cultivates senior professionals in business administration who have the knowledge and ability in management, economy, law and enterprise management, and can engage in management, teaching and scientific research in enterprises, institutions and government departments. After four years of study, graduates should master the basic principles of management and economics, as well as the basic theories and knowledge of modern enterprise management; Grasp the qualitative and quantitative analysis methods of enterprise management; Strong language and written expression, interpersonal communication and basic ability to analyze and solve enterprise management problems; Be familiar with the relevant guidelines, policies and regulations of enterprise management and the practices and rules of international enterprise management; Understand the theoretical frontier and development trends of this discipline; Master the basic methods of literature retrieval and data query, and have preliminary scientific research and practical work ability. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Courses may change every year, so they are only for reference. Management, microeconomics, macroeconomics, management information system, statistics, accounting, financial management, marketing, economic law, human resource management, finance and taxation, finance, real estate development and management, real estate regulations, real estate appraisal, project management, enterprise strategic management, etc. 3. Employment Direction Editor Notes: Many of the gtaduates are engaged in various industrial and commercial enterprises, financial institutions and government economic management departments. After graduation, students can be employed in various industrial and commercial enterprises, financial institutions and government economic management departments. You can obtain graduate students in economics and management, as well as professional qualification certificates such as asset appraisers, real estate appraisers, certified public accountants and tax agents, cost engineers, ISO9000 certification, etc. 4. Introduction of School of Business Editor Notes: Recently, the graduate employment rate has been above 90%, and graduates with comprehensive quality and outstanding competence were widely praised by enterprises and bosses. The School of Business (SB) has 96 employees. Among them, there are 47 professors and associate professors, 51 doctors and doctor candidates. The school is privileged for a number of phenomenal academics, such as an expert with State-Council Allowance, 2 middle-aged and young experts with outstanding contributions in Shandong Province, a well-known technical expert in Shandong Province and 2 college-level distinguished teachers. SB has 4 research centers, 3 research institutes, 3 laboratories and 24 teaching and practice bases. The school also reaches mutual credit recognition and cooperation agreements with Australia, the United States, France and other foreign universities. 5.
